object_description: simple two-story building with a differentiated roof landscape
design_condition: The building follows the existing school's orientation, closes the western break area, and leaves reduced outdoor areas to the west and south while improving northern access with a covered forecourt.

positive.statement: The differentiated roof shape gives the new building a definite identity and independent presence.

position.rationale: Varied roof bands and stepped upper form are clearly visible across plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The differentiated roof landscape is used well, improving daylight and natural ventilation.

position.target: roof landscape for daylight and ventilation
position.rationale: Roofscape openings and differentiated upper surfaces are directly sampled.

positive.statement: The spatial divisions retain a high level of identity despite possible changes to the layout.

position.rationale: Interior divisions are approximated along the elongated central building zone.

negative.statement: The covered connection between old and new is neither operationally nor architecturally convincing.

position.target: covered connection between old and new
position.rationale: Connection is anchored at the west edge where the adjacent existing building is implied.

negative.statement: The public pedestrian connection between the buildings remains somewhat undefined.

position.rationale: Northern edge is used because the statement identifies northern access and forecourt conditions.

negative.statement: The large footprint reduces the remaining outdoor areas to the west and south.

position.rationale: Reduced outdoor space is anchored along the west and south perimeter of the large footprint.

negative.statement: The complex statics create structural and technical risks that are difficult to predict financially.

position.rationale: Structural complexity is approximated within the central elongated volume, without distinct structural markers.

negative.statement: The less compact, flat structure has a cost-increasing effect.

position.rationale: Long footprint and extended elevations visibly support the compactness criticism.
